message.content: {"basis": "The x-axis orders years from 1880 (left) to 1891 (right), and the y-axis encodes the number of tourists increasing upward (0 to 3,500). The plotted blue line for new tourists starts at approximately 1,100 in 1880 and ends at approximately 3,200 in 1891. Because the later endpoint is significantly higher on the vertical scale than the earlier endpoint, the overall trend for the 1880-1891 period is an increase. This supports classifying the trend as growth and routing to the growth-planning option.", "option_label": "Route to tourism growth planning"}
